thread:
marta: quick follow-up to the autoscaler RFC — proposal for an 'observer-mode' + simulation endpoint so we can stage policy changes without touching prod.
kevin: curious, how is this different from running the existing dry-run? will it still affect headroom calc?
sriniv: short: dry-run today runs against current state and mutates metrics. observer-mode should be read-only and run speculative provisioning on a cloned intent graph.
julia: yes please. last time I flipped the policy we accidentally triggered a scale-up due to metric side effects.
kevin: sketch: add /autoscaler/simulate POST that accepts policy, time-window, and workload trace, returns time-series of provisioned nodes + risk flags.
marta: exactly. also include a mode to run 'rollout-scan' that runs a canary sequence across N simulated tenants to find oscillation cases.
infra-bot: note: creating simulation API will require CPU-bound simulator service (k8s job) and snapshotting of recent telemetry (1h). cost estimate ~ low.
ops-bot: +1 for non-invasive testing. can we also surface the simulation diff as a CI artifact for PRs that touch autoscaler code?
julia: idea: couple with a policy-lint that rejects policies with >X% simulated oscillation or >Y% tail latency regressions.
sriniv: example simulate payload (proto):
```
POST /autoscaler/simulate
{
  "policy": "policy_v2.json",
  "window": "30m",
  "trace": "tenant:burst-2025-02-10",
  "sim_options": { "prefill_cache": true, "allow_burst_credit": false }
}
```
kevin: and response example:
```
{
  "provisioned_gpus": [0,0,1,3,6,6,4],
  "predicted_latency_p95_ms": [80,82,120,140,90,85,70],
  "oscillation_score": 0.12,
  "risk": "medium"
}
```
marta: we should make the simulator aware of quotas and reservation contracts (dedicated tenant commits) so it can flag violations.
sriniv: major implementation note: simulator must not call allocator or modify DB. clone the intent state into an in-memory model.
kevin: ops concern: snapshotting telemetry could be large. propose using aggregated sliding window summaries for simulation to keep input size small.
julia: UX: add a GH action that runs simulations on PRs changing autoscaler or admission logic and uploads a summarized diff to the PR checks.
infra-bot: perf note: simulate many tenants in parallel will need batch workers. recommend initial MVP: single-tenant trace + 10-tenant canary scan.
ops-bot: rollout plan: 1) MVP API + local dev tool 2) CI integration for PRs 3) nightly simulation-run of current policies against synthetic worst-case traces 4) UI in console to preview policy impact.
marta: policy language change: we might want to expose a 'stability_budget' param per policy that the simulator uses to compute oscillation_score.
kevin: question: should simulation be stochastic (randomized workload sampling) or deterministic? stochastic helps find rare failure modes but is flaky in CI.
sriniv: do both. deterministic for CI (repro), stochastic for canary-scan and nightly fuzzing.
julia: also add a flag to simulate quantization/slow-start of GPU nodes to model real provisioning lag.
kevin: good call. otherwise we under-estimate tail latency.
marta: next steps: I'll draft a short design doc (link) and a toy impl in the autoscaler repo. would appreciate pseudocode review.
kevin: can you add an owner for the simulator infra? I'll volunteer to help on the CI/PR integration side.
marta: thanks, Kevin. owner: kevin + sriniv. I'll drop the doc in https://redwood.internal/docs/autosim later today. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deployed simulator-mvp ticket created (#INFRA-8421)
